allow: PowerShell(Invoke-WebRequest -Uri "http://localhost:3000/api/teams" -UseBasicParsing | Select-Object -ExpandProperty Content | ConvertFrom-Json | Select-Object -ExpandProperty teams | Select-Object -First 5 | Format-Table teamId, displayName, abbreviation)
PowerShell($result = Invoke-WebRequest -Uri "http://localhost:3000/api/teams/2/leaders" -UseBasicParsing | Select-Object -ExpandProperty Content | ConvertFrom-Json; $result.leaders | Format-List)

PowerShell($data = Invoke-WebRequest -Uri "https://site.api.espn.com/apis/site/v2/sports/basketball/nba/scoreboard" -UseBasicParsing | Select-Object -ExpandProperty Content | ConvertFrom-Json; $event = $data.events | Select-Object -First 1; $status = $event.status; Write-Output "state: $\($status.type.state\)"; Write-Output "description: $\($status.type.description\)"; Write-Output "detail: $\($status.type.detail\)"; Write-Output "shortDetail: $\($status.type.shortDetail\)"; Write-Output "displayClock: $\($status.displayClock\)"; Write-Output "period: $\($status.period\)"; Write-Output "clock: $\($status.clock\)")
